subject: Launch gate decision log + fallback scenarios — Medvera pilot
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.inference>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@medvera.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@medvera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-27T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Launch gate decision & fallback plan — Medvera pilot

Hi Elaine / Tom,

Thanks again for the session yesterday — good progress. As requested, I'm attaching the updated mutual action plan (MAP_Medvera_v3.xlsx) which contains the near-term launch gate checklist and owners.

High level ask for this week: can we lock the cutover date (tentative: 2026-11-15) or confirm any blocking procurement or security items that would push it? If you can confirm by EOD Friday 2026-10-30 we can finalize the runbook and schedule the dry run.

Key open items on our side (from the MAP):
- Finalize SCIM role mapping (owner: Ben Carter) — target 2026-11-02
- Confirm SSO cert rotation window (owner: Lauren Bishop) — target 2026-11-06
- Agree on fallback model variant and cost SLA for heavy traffic burst (owner: Maya Srinivasan) — target 2026-11-08

Attached: MAP_Medvera_v3.xlsx 
Also attaching a draft runbook (cutover_runbook_v2.docx) with step-by-step cutover and rollback stubs. I included a short fallback matrix for degraded throughput.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 30m gating call on 2026-10-29 to confirm gate criteria and dry-run date.
- Procurement to confirm invoice/PO timing (cc procurement@medvera.com).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: MAP_Medvera_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), cutover_runbook_v2.docx (doc)

From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@medvera.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@medvera.com>, procurement@medvera.com
Date: 2026-10-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch gate decision & fallback plan — Medvera pilot

Maya — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. We reviewed the MAP and have a few clarifications from procurement and security: 

1) Procurement: PO approval is on track but finance needs the final SOW numbers by 2026-11-04. If you anticipate material changes to consumption estimates please flag now.

2) Security: Our InfoSec team flagged the cert rotation window as potentially impacting our internal monitoring; they prefer rotation during off-hours (US Eastern 02:00-04:00). Can Lauren confirm if the rotation can be scheduled in that window?

3) Fallback: We want clarity on what you mean by "fallback model variant" — does this incur a separate billing tier or degrade output quality? We need examples to present to clinical ops.

We can do the 30m call on 2026-10-29 at 10:30 AM PT. Tom and I will join along with procurement.

Elaine
Director, Clinical Integrations | Medvera Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch gate decision & fallback plan — Medvera pilot

Looping in a few specifics from engineering after taking a look at the runbook: 

- SCIM role mapping: I can prepare the mapping export; will need a sample user from Medvera (an id with full clinical access) to validate IDs. ETA: 2026-11-02 as noted.
- Fallback model variant: we proposed a lower-cost 8-bit quantized variant that reduces per-token cost ~30% but sometimes truncates long clinical note paraphrases. Impact: high-level templates and short summaries remain fine; detailed free-text hallucination risk slightly higher. If Medvera prefers, we can also enable token-level prefix caching to mitigate cost without switching model variant.

I'll add a one-page comparison to the MAP spreadsheet before the call.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments referenced: comparison_fallback_options.txt (note)

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.inference>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@medvera.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@medvera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-29T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch gate decision & fallback plan — Medvera pilot

Thanks all — confirmed for 10:30 AM PT today. Quick pre-read for the call: I put two concrete fallback workflows into the runbook:

A) Graceful degrade (preferred): Keep primary model, throttle non-essential ephemerals, enable prefix caching for common templates. No model switch; cost impact small.
B) Variant switch (emergency): Route to quantized model variant with a pre-approved clinical disclaimer and audit logging. Slightly lower fidelity for very long notes.

During the call we'll walk the gating checklist and mark any items that block the 2026-11-15 cutover. Please bring: procurement timeline (Elaine), cert rotation window (Tom), and a sample user for SCIM testing.

See you shortly.

Maya

From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@medvera.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@medvera.com>, procurement@medvera.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch gate decision & fallback plan — Medvera pilot

Thanks everyone for the call earlier — summary and decisions below. Forwarding notes here for audit and to seed the MAP.

Meeting notes (2026-11-03):
- Decision: Proceed to scheduling dry-run week of 2026-11-08; cutover target remains 2026-11-15. 
- Procurement: Finance will issue PO on 2026-11-04 after SOW is confirmed (Elaine to confirm final numbers).
- SSO cert rotation: Tom confirmed rotation can be scheduled 2026-11-12 02:00-04:00 ET. Lauren to execute and notify 24h prior.
- SCIM test: Medvera will provide a sample user by 2026-11-02 (Tom). Ben to validate mapping 2026-11-02 - 2026-11-04.
- Fallback decision: Use Graceful degrade (Workflow A) as primary fallback. Variant switch (Workflow B) is reserved for emergency only. Both workflows are documented in cutover_runbook_v2.docx.

Action items (owner / due):
- Elaine: Confirm final SOW numbers and forward to procurement (due 2026-11-04)
- Tom: Share sample SCIM user (due 2026-11-02)
- Ben: Upload fallback comparison and finalize SCIM mapping (due 2026-11-04)
- Lauren: Schedule cert rotation and post notice (due 2026-11-11)
- Maya: Publish updated MAP with these decisions and circulate to stakeholders (due 2026-11-05)

Attachments: updated meeting notes saved to Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Medvera-MAP) and rollback_playbook.pdf for audit.

Elaine
Director, Clinical Integrations | Medvera Health
